message:
Retain a complete page with a 50-character shorter constant recipe

Enumerate the same943 BFS Wang tiles directly instead of printing a
sorting key and its 40-bit rank formula. Include the literal initializer4,
justified by the full decoded first target, and every index explanation.
The complete constant recipe drops2393 to2343 nonwhite printed characters;
the full page drops3217 to3167 at the same ten positive unknowns,
98 operations, exact degree360 and one-Letter-page9-point layout.

The selector permutation fixes Start0/Forbidden1 but changes DC and K.
Supply the full ordinary native/controller proof for the new coherent
tuple, rebuilding fresh words/rank and checking its new controller units.
Retain the entire standalone PDF and TeX, full four-integer payloads,
all430 transition and943 color conjugacies and66062 native basis checks.
Do not assert equality of specialized polynomials or old/new native words.

All eight fresh root build/render/check/artifact runs in normal and
optimized modes byte-match author records. Each artifact run rejects40
actual corruptions and passes two complete controls. Root reviews the
full proof/code/printed table and visually inspects the delivered page;
close39 files and authenticate131 peer-bound dependencies.

Keep the canonical98/360 PDF and TeX unchanged while batching this minor
recipe gain with future improvements. Lean stays paused and the size
reduction goal remains active.

Reduce the complete direct quartic family to 569 integer variables

Append the raw106 square only to the common frame, keep actual call3's
ports unchanged, and remove its direct sign predicate. The separately
reviewed ordinary proof orients the t pair with independent calls8/9,
recovers raw106=f^t from its signed residue and absolute frame bound,
then restores the exact delayed bound130 and prefix before later decoding.
Fresh completeness rebuilds W, A and every private Pell witness.

Retain complete RAW/CSE systems, inverse certificates and expanded
quartics for all24 configurations. The best measured equation has569
integer variables,363 residuals,7197 terms, degree4 and unchanged height
2445790974704. Record the three distinct measured delta classes rather
than extrapolating a uniform saving from the deleted guard.

Both source checks, both full finite checks and both deterministic
rebuilds pass fresh root runs. Independent finite peer replays match the
author; a separate stdlib collector verifies all48 old/new quartics and
all24 coordinate/row comparisons. Close both packet inventories and bind
all source, policy, projection and review bytes.

Update current comparisons and source-calibration review, preserving all
predecessors. Refresh the stale status-page description of the already
published98-operation/degree360 PDF. The canonical equation PDF/TeX itself
is unchanged by this quartic result; Lean remains paused.

Retain complete 97-operation and 102-operation square-weight alternatives

Reuse the existing strong-ordinate square in the transport majorant and delete its private kI product. The unchanged pre-transport kernels give I>k>H, and the positive polynomial n shear preserves the full parent center. Independently check every source row, coherent coefficient payload, actual center/shear, complete norm and leading form. Exact degrees are 368 and 344: these save one multiplication against 98/360 and 103/332 with a higher degree, so preserve the current canonical page.

Validation: full ordinary/literal/degree root review; six fresh normal/optimized rebuild, checker and actual-artifact commands PASS and match the final sealed evidence. Both artifact modes pass two positive controls and reject 27 changed private copies. All 32 payload members, nested manifest and Git inclusion verified. Update five research summaries and retain the original lead note. Lean remains paused; no new formal endpoint or optimality claim.

Publish the complete 98-operation degree-360 consistency equation

Replace the transport product HI by kI in both complete ten-positive
kernels. Before any transport sign or denominator cancellation, the
unchanged Pell classification proves k>=8X(muY)^2+4>H. The smaller
syntactic-degree register therefore supplies the full old majorization.
Every later rank, parity, whole-product projection and source contract
retains its hypotheses. The positive polynomial shear
n_new=n_old+(k-H)I*B preserves the complete center for every accepted old
zero. No positive inverse map on arbitrary new zeros is assumed.

The complete graphs retain 98 and 103 operations with exact degrees 360
and 332. Their centered norm has unique leading part 16*v0^2*h0^2;
the other norm product cannot cancel it. Authenticate the actual front
leading components, selected nonzero coefficients, complete 35-coefficient
norm and every unchanged source row, with all four coherent coefficients
carried together. Preserve all prior arithmetic packets and endpoints.

Update equation.pdf and standalone equation.tex together to the checked
98/360 equation: three fewer operations and eight fewer degrees than the
former 101/368 display, with the same ten positive unknowns. All constants
remain printed on one Letter page in 9-point body type, including the
verbatim 436-character seed, decoder, 943 tiles and full coefficient recipe.
Preserve the former page and its TeX. Bind the new display in
CURRENT_EQUATION.json, add a closed page packet and root reviews, update
five summaries, and record the successful continuation of the degree-budget
research. Commit both standalone and template TeX sources.

Validation: full author/peer/root ordinary proof and literal reviews;
six fresh root source rebuild/check/artifact-audit runs PASS, matching the
sealed records; both modes reject 27 real artifact corruptions. A separate
portable parser checks all 39 actual TeX definitions and the boxed output
against all 98 live gates over free coefficient ports. Normal/optimized
full renders and tuple reconstructions PASS with identical PDF/TeX and
payload bytes, 66,062 native identities, exact seed/glyph extraction,
one-page/no-overflow checks and root visual inspection. Closed inventories,
all staged member hashes and git diff --cached --check pass. Diagnostic
text alone has trailing whitespace normalized. Lean remains paused; no
new internal-ZFC theorem, consistency assertion or global optimum claimed.

Reduce complete direct quartics to 572 integers using an existing square

Replace only the first power output's frame occurrence by its existing
square, remove its scalar guard, and preserve every other source row and
actual semantic port. The complete 63-predicate ordinary proof substitutes
an independently positive call8 output in both earlier t-orientation
arguments. Only after the t pair is fully positive does call0's signed
residue recover the omitted output sign. The later native proof resumes
at its restored interfaces; completeness constructs new W/A/Pell data.

Exactly bind that source theorem to all 24 full RAW/CSE equations and
integer inverse certificates. The best quartic has 572 variables, 364
residuals, 7,211 terms and height 2,445,790,974,704 at degree four.
Every corresponding profile saves three variables, one residual and
fourteen terms at unchanged quartic height. Full retention comparison
shows that precisely the three former scalar-guard auxiliaries disappear;
the output and its existing square both remain retained. Preserve all
575-variable and lower-height predecessors, raw106 and other guards.

Validation: root read the ordinary proof, checker changes and both peer
audits, the complete finite producer/checker, policies, frame and CSE
identities, and final reviews. Six fresh ordinary replays, both complete
finite checker modes and both full deterministic rebuilds PASS and match
sealed author/peer bytes. All 24 profiles, 89 corruption controls, 127
immutable input pins and both closed inventories verified. Update five
summaries and add the combined root review. No Lean work; the compact
canonical page is unchanged at this quartic checkpoint.

Qualify the compact kernel degree budget and retain open encoding routes

Review the new next-steps note against the complete weighted/short transport proofs. Correct the degree-four product example and the pre-divisibility bound on W/(q-1); distinguish the existing construction from an unproved degree floor. Explain why a direct S substitution loses transport information without asserting that every one-word encoding is impossible. This documentation correction introduces no new equation or metric claim. Validation: source-proof comparison and git diff --check; canonical PDF/TeX and paused Lean unchanged.

Reduce the direct quartic consistency family from 591 to 575 integers

Replace eight range-numerator occurrences in the common frame by their
squares, and remove only their eight quotient nonnegativity guards. The
ordinary 64-predicate proof recovers positive power outputs before deriving
the missing quotient signs, with every strict constructor, lower bound,
seed alias and deferred sign step checked. Fresh completeness rebuilds the
new frame and private Pell data; no literal old frame equality is reused.

Bind the ordinary source proof and independent dependency/basic audits to
all 24 complete RAW/CSE quartics and their signed inverse certificates.
The best default CSE equation has 575 integer variables, 365 residuals,
7,225 terms, degree four and coefficient height 2,445,790,974,704: sixteen
fewer variables and 2,432 fewer terms at the same height. Retention records
explain the net saving: twenty-four guard auxiliaries disappear, eight
numerator outputs become retained, and all eight appended squares vanish.
Preserve lower-height alternatives and every predecessor.

Validation: root read all proof/checker/producer sources; six fresh ordinary
replays, both complete finite checks and both deterministic rebuilds PASS.
Independent peer checks match the sealed normal/optimized receipts exactly;
all 24 profiles and 86 corruption controls pass. Both closed inventories,
member hashes, immutable pins and canonical PDF/TeX hashes verified.
Update five research summaries and add the combined root review.
Lean remains paused; the canonical compact ten-positive page is unchanged.

Record why the ten-positive kernel is at its degree floor and what a smaller equation needs

NEXT_STEPS.md beside the four-root equation: the degree budget of its
99 / 368 descendant (omega = 30 + 25 + 37, N = omega^4) with each register
at the minimum the architecture allows; two measured ideas that lose
(double centering, product square); the two-residue argument showing why
F and alpha are both necessary for the compact44 transport; and the two
structural directions (a one-word transport in the compiler, or a
Lean-checked direct quartic) that could give a significantly smaller
equation.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Fix 31 defects found auditing batch 227

An independent read-only audit of the wave-11 reconciliation (c96b5183d5)
and its pointers (366dfc3dc7) against the five dossiers, the placed
directories and git found 31 defects; all are fixed here.

Wrong facts: seventeen arrival commits, not nineteen (six places in three
files); the thirteen-integer frontier is 105's 1,072 / 186, 1,392 / 177 and
1,408 / 176 evaluators of 88's polynomials, not 97's 190; those four
identities were missing from the identities bullet; 87's coefficient height
is 320,307,372,009,918 (the sentence blaming 94's COMPARISON.json is
removed); 73's thirteen-positive 30 / 92 is a Pareto point (74 evaluates it
in 93); the direct-quartic rows had dominated points marked best (100's 407,
104's 1,190, 99's 1,685, 103's 3,292 "fewest terms", 89's 6,183 "lowest
height", 95's 895 "fewest terms") and the wrong lineage arrow 87 -> 89:
108's 687 has the fewest integer terms (5,602), 98's 4,860 the lowest
natural height (1,837), 108's 655-variable source the fewest natural terms
(3,748); 110 (and in the pointers 88) listed among direct-quartic
packages; 85's 18Z 88 / 105 and 19Z 32 / 108 missing from the 18Z-20Z row;
the compact44 and source-34 tuple attributions (85, 101, 105); the
twelve-positive restriction stated backwards; 101 wrongly among in-place
writers, 81, 89 and 104 missing; six root NOTICE omissions and two README
title differences (86, 93) missing.

Inconsistencies: the direct-route table covered only two lineages without
saying so; "eight packages" encode C222 directly where sixteen do; the
headline called 108's quartics the route's first finished equations; the
research session's direct candidates are at 399 naturals and 610 integers,
not "below 400 variables"; 211 / 111 listed among dominating candidates;
the wrapper sentence implied six wrappers differ.

Editorial: stale wave ranges (6-10, wave-7 to wave-10), the licence table
without a wave-11 row, the restored count stated as members only (1,119
members = 1,108 staged files), 84's title taken from PDF metadata instead
of its title page, heights up to 9*10^21, 110's 1,024 / 179 omitted from a
dominance claim, 68's local-step copies in 76, 83, 93 and 98 omitted, and
a garbled sentence about 94 and 103.
